data: Which embedding size has the highest MRR for n-CP?

The left graph shows the MRR values for three models: n-CP, n-TuckER, and GETD, across different embedding sizes. The x-axis represents the embedding dimensionality, ranging from 5 to 35. The y-axis represents the MRR values, which range from approximately 0.20 to 0.40. 

To determine which embedding size has the highest MRR for n-CP, we need to observe the trend of the green line (n-CP) across the different embedding sizes. The green line appears to peak at an embedding size of around 10, where the MRR value is approximately 0.35. As the embedding size increases further, the MRR value for n-CP decreases slightly. Therefore, the embedding size with the highest MRR for n-CP is approximately 10.
